== Description ==
'''UI-220''' is the 10th entity you may encounter within [[Section Interchange]], more info below.

== Behavior ==
When '''UI-220''' spawns, it will play the composition known as "Horror Race", like all the other entities that reside within the I-Section. If there are more entities present, it will play the same song but with a higher pitch and speed.

it will appear from the back and rush to the main room, after it hits the door will will rush back, it will repeat this a couple times while screaming loudly before despawning at its spawn point 

== Strategy & Tips ==
Hide as soon as you hear its screams, and dont exit your hiding spot untill horror race lowers in volume to indicate theres no entities active.

== Trivia ==
* Like most UI entities, '''UI-220''' was added as a joke.
